purpose: Rank evidence-backed implementation options for the next article-processing pipeline milestone.

scope_boundary.notes: This roadmap ranks implementation options from M030 audit evidence. It does not register catalog records, acquire sources, replay parsing/chunking, approve graph readiness, write LadybugDB, or attempt production import.

source_evidence.used_for: Owner modules, likely touched files, verifiers, and fail-closed graph/import boundary representation.
Readiness claim states and next actions by pipeline stage.
Requirement impact and conservative coverage classifications.
Continuity edge states, known breakpoints B01-B03, and fail-closed diagnostic contract.

priority_factors: Unblocks downstream continuity edges for the M030 selected refs.
Has direct audit evidence and concrete owner modules.
Can be verified locally before any network, graph, or production write claim.
Reduces false readiness risk by preserving fail-closed constraints.

risk_scale.low: Metadata or validator-local work with no external writes beyond repository artifacts.
risk_scale.medium: Replay or transformation work touching filesystem artifacts and multiple stage contracts.
risk_scale.high: Work adjacent to trusted graph readiness or import boundaries where false positives could authorize unsafe writes.

ranked_options.title: Catalog coverage remediation for missing M030 refs
ranked_options.dependency_state: Depends only on validated URL intake selection m029-pipeline-architecture-audit-v1.
ranked_options.why_ranked_here: Continuity breakpoint B01 blocks all downstream M030 replay. Metadata-only catalog rows for stanford:cs224n:gradient-notes and arxiv:2605.29548 are the smallest safe action that creates stable article_ref boundaries without claiming acquisition, parser, chunk, or graph readiness.
audit_evidence: S05 B01_missing_m030_catalog_records: selection.json reports 2 missing_from_article_catalog refs: stanford:cs224n:gradient-notes and arxiv:2605.29548.
S03 article_catalog claim_state=partial with next action to register metadata-only catalog rows and rebuild/validate index rows while keeping network_fetch_attempted=false.

requirements_advanced.impact: Preserves command/input/output hash and context provenance for generated catalog artifacts.
Advances the project-wide audit constraint by keeping registration bounded, local, and evidence-backed.
Removes the first blocker before parser/conversion and graph-readiness evidence can be replayed.

acceptance_signals: Both missing normalized identities are represented as metadata-only catalog records.
Article catalog index rebuild/validation passes.
network_fetch_attempted remains false for registration-only work.
No parser_ready_claimed, chunk_ready_claimed, kg_readiness_claimed, graph_write_attempted, or production_persistence_attempted flags become true.

ranked_options.title: Catalog-backed acquisition replay for requested refs
ranked_options.dependency_state: Blocked until missing M030 refs have stable catalog article_ref and variant boundaries.
ranked_options.why_ranked_here: Once catalog boundaries exist, acquisition replay creates the local source/PDF artifacts needed by loader and parser stages. It directly addresses B02 and converts source_acquisition from blocked to replay-evidenced without touching graph import.
audit_evidence: S03 source_acquisition claim_state=blocked with next action to replay controlled acquisition for the two missing refs and include already-cataloged refs in replay scope.

requirements_advanced.impact: Strengthens partial preprocessing/source evidence before staged KG validation.
Creates source artifacts required before parser/conversion and graph-readiness quality replay.
Adds replay events and summaries with provenance and stable artifact hashes.

acceptance_signals: Acquisition events and summary exist for all four requested identities or emit typed per-ref blockers.
Local source artifact paths are safe, bounded, and linked to catalog records.
Loader evidence can classify acquired artifacts with provenance, diagnostics, and safety flags.
source_acquisition_completed is only true for refs with real local captures.

ranked_options.title: Parser and conversion replay for acquired artifacts
ranked_options.recommendation: Do after catalog-backed acquisition replay has artifacts or typed blockers.
ranked_options.dependency_state: Requires loader-classified local source/PDF artifacts with provenance and parser-readiness flags.
ranked_options.why_ranked_here: Parser/conversion is the next blocked handoff after acquisition. It is required before chunk evidence can be generated, but it should not run on metadata-only or missing-source variants.
audit_evidence: S03 parser_conversion claim_state=blocked with next actions to classify the Stanford PDF through local parser path and replay arXiv PDF/HTML conversion quality.
S04 R027 and R029 remain partial until parser/conversion and graph-readiness evidence exists.

requirements_advanced.impact: Moves preprocessing evidence from partial smoke coverage toward replayed parser/conversion coverage.
Produces conversion diagnostics required before graph-readiness quality benchmark work.
Begins the evidence chain needed before any import-ready typed package can be considered.

acceptance_signals: Parser-ready artifacts produce converted text with sha256 and byte_size.
Metadata-only or not_parser_ready variants remain explicit refusals, not silent successes.
Raw text or binary payloads are not embedded into metadata-only outputs.
parser_ready_claimed remains false for unreplayed or refused refs.

ranked_options.title: Chunking replay and evidence-path validation
ranked_options.recommendation: Do after parser/conversion replay proves usable converted text.
ranked_options.dependency_state: Requires converted text artifacts and parsed element streams for parser-ready refs.
ranked_options.why_ranked_here: Chunk evidence is future-scope until parser output exists. It should follow parser replay and must preserve retrieval-only versus graph-import-eligible distinctions.
audit_evidence: S03 chunking claim_state=future-scope with next actions to run PageIndex/semantic chunk evidence only after parser output is available and usable.
S05 failure modes require zero-chunk parser-ready variants and evidence_path_count=0 to block readiness promotion.

requirements_advanced.impact: Adds chunk/pre-KG preprocessing evidence without claiming KG import readiness.
Provides evidence paths and chunk package metrics needed by future import-ready package checks.
Moves toward deterministic pre-KG manifests with stable IDs, source spans, candidate links, review states, and kg_import_allowed=false.

acceptance_signals: Chunk IDs, section anchors, bounds, source spans, and repair diagnostics are recorded.
Parser-ready variants with zero chunks fail closed with explicit diagnostics.
Retrieval-only chunks remain distinct from import-eligible chunks.
chunk_ready_claimed remains false for unreplayed or insufficient refs.

ranked_options.title: Graph-readiness reviewer package generation and independent review gate
ranked_options.recommendation: Do after chunking replay produces complete evidence paths.
ranked_options.dependency_state: Requires source, parser, chunk, evidence-path, and source-span coverage for each candidate ref.
ranked_options.why_ranked_here: This is necessary before any trusted KG claim, but it is high-risk because a false positive could authorize graph-import eligibility. It must remain a review package and gate, not an import operation.
audit_evidence: S03 graph_readiness_review claim_state=future-scope with next action to create reviewer packets from chunk evidence and require independent review before import eligibility.
S04 R051 and R052 are gated_future_scope until review/AI-related validation fixtures exist.

requirements_advanced.impact: Provides the graph-readiness quality review evidence required before positive readiness claims.
Establishes the independent review gate needed before import-ready typed packages are accepted.
Produces review-state manifests while preserving kg_import_allowed=false until gates pass.
Can later host schema-validated review fixtures, but remains gated until no-import authorization boundaries are proven.
Can later supply deterministic benchmark baselines before any optimizer activation recommendation.

acceptance_signals: Reviewer packets include source spans, evidence paths, chunk metrics, and explicit unsafe-to-claim reasons.
Independent review decision events are required before any trusted_kg_import_allowed transition.
Refs lacking source, parser, chunk, or reviewer evidence remain refused.
kg_readiness_claimed remains false without completed independent review.

ranked_options.title: Graph import boundary hardening and fail-closed rehearsal
ranked_options.recommendation: Do last, and only as no-write rehearsal until review gates pass.
ranked_options.dependency_state: Requires completed graph-readiness review and import contract metrics; must not bypass no-write constraints.
ranked_options.why_ranked_here: Import boundary work is important but should not lead the next implementation milestone. M030 evidence says graph import is unsafe-to-claim, so this option should harden refusal/no-write behavior before any real import path is enabled.
audit_evidence: S05 B03_retrieval_only_not_graph_import_ready: M027 baseline and replay summaries keep graph_import_allowed=false, trusted_kg_import_allowed=false, ladybugdb_written=false, and production_import_attempted=false.
S03 graph_import_boundary claim_state=unsafe-to-claim with next action to use fail-closed import rehearsal only after graph-readiness review passes.

requirements_advanced.impact: Hardens the final gate for import-ready typed packages without claiming production import readiness.
Preserves kg_import_allowed=false unless all import contract and review gates pass.
Keeps graph/LadybugDB write risk bounded by explicit go/no-go decisions and failure-mode analysis.

acceptance_signals: import_ready=false or import_eligible_chunk_count=0 blocks graph import deterministically.
trusted_kg_import_allowed=false keeps graph_import_allowed=false.
ladybugdb_written=false and production_import_attempted=false remain invariant in no-write rehearsal.
Any write-capable path fails closed rather than attempting LadybugDB writes from retrieval-only chunks.

recommended_next_milestone_shape.title: Catalog-backed replay to graph-readiness refusal boundary
recommended_next_milestone_shape.strategy: Implement the first safe vertical path through catalog registration, acquisition replay, parser/conversion replay, chunk evidence, and graph-readiness review package generation while preserving no-write graph/import boundaries.

candidate_slices.title: Metadata-only catalog remediation
acceptance_criteria: stanford:cs224n:gradient-notes and arxiv:2605.29548 exist as metadata-only catalog rows.
No network fetch, parser, chunk, KG readiness, graph write, or production persistence claim is made.

candidate_slices.title: Catalog-backed source acquisition and loader evidence replay
acceptance_criteria: Replay emits acquisition events and summaries for all four requested identities or typed blockers.
Loader evidence links every successful artifact to catalog identity, source path, provenance, and diagnostics.

candidate_slices.title: Parser/conversion replay with refusal diagnostics
acceptance_criteria: Parser-ready artifacts produce verified converted text artifacts.
Metadata-only and not-parser-ready variants remain explicit fail-closed refusals.

candidate_slices.title: Chunk evidence replay and graph-readiness package
acceptance_criteria: Chunk packages include stable IDs, section anchors, source spans, evidence paths, and diagnostics.
Reviewer packets are generated but kg_import_allowed remains false until independent review completes.

candidate_slices.title: No-write graph import boundary rehearsal
acceptance_criteria: Import contract refusal/no-write states are deterministic and tested.
ladybugdb_written=false and production_import_attempted=false remain true invariants for this milestone.

out_of_scope_until_later: Production graph import or LadybugDB writes.
Trusted KG import approval without completed independent graph-readiness review.
DSPy, RLM, MiniMax, or optimizer activation beyond explicitly gated fixtures.
Future 30-paper deviation scans or automated +10 validation-batch loops.

fail_closed_constraints: source_acquisition_completed=false for M030 selection gaps until real local captures exist.
ladybugdb_written=false unless a future explicitly approved write-capable milestone changes the boundary.

verification_contract.health_signal: Roadmap recommendations link to M030 audit evidence, module/function references, requirement IDs, and fail-closed constraints.
verification_contract.failure_signal: Any option missing evidence-backed module/function references, dependencies, requirement impact, or graph/import no-write constraints is not ready for handoff.
